long_biography.plain_text:
Marina Berlusconi built her executive career inside Fininvest, the holding company created by her father, Silvio Berlusconi. She moved from deputy chair to chair and also became chair of Mondadori, overseeing a group centred on books, education, retail and digital media. Her long tenure established an operating identity distinct from ownership alone.

After her father's death, Berlusconi and her brother Pier Silvio inherited the majority of the family holdings and agreed to exercise dominant influence over Fininvest jointly. The group combines controlling media interests with a substantial stake in Banca Mediolanum. Berlusconi continues to chair both Fininvest and Mondadori and serves as a non-executive director of MFE-MEDIAFOREUROPE. Her role joins active corporate stewardship with inherited family control.
